title: A Class Looks Back: Our First Month · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about a problem in your class last week. Use was/were, because, and be going to. Example: The room was small. We were not happy because there were no chairs. We are going to use a new room.
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
